title_zh: 互联网平台与数字广告 KPI
sector_scope: Digital Advertising, Social/Search Platforms, Streaming & Online Marketplaces (SEC SIC 4832-4841, 4899, 7310-7319, 7370, 7375, 7812, 7841)

kpis.name_zh: 用户规模、ARPU 与货币化率
kpis.definition_and_formula: DAU/MAU/DAP or paid subs YoY/QoQ; ARPU = Segment Revenue / Avg Users; Take Rate = Net Revenue / GMV
kpis.where_to_look: MD&A Operational Metrics, 8-K 99.1 KPI table & earnings call
red_flags: Core geography user growth stalling while ARPU relies solely on ad load
Take rate compression or removal of previously reported user/engagement metric

kpis.name_en: Ad Impressions vs Price per Ad
kpis.name_zh: 广告展示量与单价拆解
kpis.definition_and_formula: Ad Revenue YoY growth decomposed into Impressions YoY % and Average Price per Ad / CPM YoY %
kpis.where_to_look: MD&A Revenue Drivers & earnings call prepared remarks/Q&A
red_flags: Price-per-ad turning negative while impression growth slows
Monetization shift toward lower-CPM surfaces without offsetting conversion lift

kpis.name_zh: AI 资本开支与折旧周期
kpis.definition_and_formula: CapEx / Revenue %, D&A growth vs Revenue growth, and server/network useful-life accounting changes
kpis.where_to_look: Cash flow statement, PP&E Note (R*.htm), Critical Accounting Estimates redline
red_flags: CapEx/Revenue jumping while FCF margin drops and D&A lags CapEx surge
Server useful-life extension inflating GAAP operating margin

kpis.name_zh: 流量获取成本 (TAC) 与内容分成
kpis.definition_and_formula: TAC % = TAC / Ad or Partner Revenue; ex-TAC net revenue growth & gross-vs-net accounting basis
kpis.where_to_look: COGS / Revenue Note (R*.htm) & MD&A cost of revenue discussion
red_flags: TAC % rising >= 100bps YoY signaling distribution/partner bargaining pressure
Gross vs net revenue recognition shift inflating top-line growth

filing_focus: Disaggregated Revenue by Ad / Cloud / Platform & Geography (R*.htm)

counter_evidence_angles.angle: AI CapEx wave outrunning monetization and compressing FCF conversion
counter_evidence_angles.evidence_anchor: CapEx/Rev surge + D&A ramp or FCF/NI drop in earnings_quality_diagnostics
counter_evidence_angles.next_quarter_trigger: Next-Q CapEx guidance raised again while revenue growth decelerates

counter_evidence_angles.angle: Useful-life depreciation extension or rising TAC masking underlying margin erosion
counter_evidence_angles.evidence_anchor: sec_redline_diff PP&E useful-life policy change or TAC/Rev bps expansion
counter_evidence_angles.next_quarter_trigger: Next-Q ex-TAC gross margin or D&A-adjusted operating margin falls YoY

unit_and_period_checks: DAU vs MAU vs monetizable user definitions kept distinct
Gross GMV/revenue vs net ex-TAC revenue distinguished
Constant-currency vs reported ad/ARPU growth separated

reconciliation.note: verify implied ad revenue growth ties to disclosed impression and price % deltas
include finance-lease additions alongside cash CapEx

limits: Several platforms disclose impression/price deltas qualitatively or omit TAC outside ad-network segments
